Aug 19, 2026 · Week 17
🏆 Week 17 Winner — Mike Marino Tops the Night at 38 Points
Mike Marino takes Week 17 honours with 38 Stableford points, shooting 74 gross off his 4 handicap. Lyle Pidzarko finishes 2nd with 37 pts. 24 paid players in the field.
📈 Season Lead — Edwin Margawang Holds #1 at 371 pts
Edwin Margawang holds #1 in the season standings with 371 pts, a 5-point edge over Vikas Patel and Fady Hayek, tied for 2nd at 366. Alessandro Carnovale holds 4th at 360.
🥇 Low Gross — Giovanni Guzzo Cards 73
Giovanni Guzzo (scratch) posts the field's low gross round with a 73, good for 35 Stableford points. Runners-up Mike Marino and Tom Kenny each carded 74.
📅 Next Up — Season Finale on Tuesday, Aug 26
Only 1 round remaining in the 2026 season! Margawang leads Patel and Hayek by 5 points at the top. Week 18 tees off Tuesday, Aug 26 at Vancouver Golf Club.

Full Results

Season Leaderboard
  • 1.Season-long competition based on your best 10 out of 18 rounds — drop your worst scores or simply skip a week.
  • 2.Similar to the FedEx Cup format — accumulate points all summer.
  • 3.Wednesday scores count from April 29 – August 26, 2026.
  • 4.Scores are converted to Stableford points; standings are based on cumulative points over the summer.
  • 5.Leaderboard is automatically updated from hole-by-hole scores via Golf Genius.
  • 6.Entry fee: $100 (essentially $10 per round).
  • 7.The top 25% of players get paid at season end.
  • 8.If you pick up on a hole, you receive 0 Stableford points for that hole — your round still counts.
  • 9.The leaderboard reflects official scores through Week 5. The season runs for 18 weeks — best 10 rounds count toward final standings.
  • 10.Ties are broken PGA Tour style — countback to the next-best non-counting round (then the one after that, and so on). If players remain truly tied, they share equally the combined prize money for the positions involved.
